What We Learned

  1. Lemma 2 and Lemma 3 are significant divisibility properties for polynomials with integer coefficient.
  2. Lemma 4 provides a useful connection between exponential divisibility and prime factors. For more application, see Putnam 1972 A5.
  3. Even when a quotient polynomial no longer satisfies the original divisibility condition, multiplicative orders and polynomial congruences may allow us to prove that it has the same root. This makes repeated factorization possible.
  4. The lifting-the-exponent lemma is particularly useful for verifying exponential divisibility conditions by comparing -adic valuations.
